title: 滑雪跳台式消能工~Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation
focus: 追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界~Tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries
summary: 本課以追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界為主線，先用挑流彈道與落點與落差與飛行時間界定水力與構造條件，再將射流功率與承受區、入水動量與方向連結到福祿尺度與表面張力。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries through Jet trajectory and landing point and Drop height and flight time, then connects Jet power and receiving zone and Impact momentum and direction to Froude scaling and surface tension. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查挑流彈道與落點：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m；再獨立檢查落差與飛行時間：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。敏感度：同高起落且挑角30度時，出口速度由20增至25m/s，理想射程由35.31增至55.17m，增加56.25%；射程隨速度平方變化但不代表沖刷深度同倍增加。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 將以多點同步壓力量測比較面積平均與局部峰值作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Jet trajectory and landing point: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m. Independently examine Drop height and flight time: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s. Sensitivity: at equal launch and landing elevation and a30-degree angle, increasing exit velocity from20 to25m/s raises ideal range from35.31 to55.17m, a56.25 percent increase. Range scales with velocity squared, whereas scour depth does not follow the same rule. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. Use the following independent check: Compare spatially averaged pressure with local peaks using synchronized pressure arrays. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 挑流彈道與落點~Jet trajectory and landing point
units.title: 挑流彈道與落點~Jet trajectory and landing point
units.mechanism: 挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。忽略阻力的質點彈道只估中心線，實際水舌會展寬、破碎與含氣；必須確認使用的是水舌離坎速度而非上游平均速度，且不能把單一落點當成整個沖擊區。 驗證時應由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程，並辨識以下失效情境：把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool. Velocity, angle and elevation difference determine the ideal trajectory. A drag-free particle model estimates a centerline, while real jets spread, fragment and aerate; use launch velocity and distinguish the landing point from the entire impact footprint. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. units.anchor: 落差與飛行時間~Drop height and flight time
units.title: 落差與飛行時間~Drop height and flight time
units.mechanism: 水舌由較高出口落入低處水面時，垂直運動包含初始向上速度與重力加速，應取二次方程的正時間根。以同高公式代替會低估射程；水位波動與射流破碎使接觸面並非固定平面，仍需量測與模型確認。 驗證時應以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程，並辨識以下失效情境：選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~For a jet launched above the pool, vertical motion includes initial upward velocity and gravity. Use the positive time root rather than the equal-elevation shortcut, which underestimates range. Pool waves and jet fragmentation make the contact surface variable, so measurements must validate the idealized trajectory. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 鼻坎曲率與壓力~Bucket curvature and pressure
units.title: 鼻坎曲率與壓力~Bucket curvature and pressure
units.mechanism: 曲面使水流向上轉彎，需要向心加速度，底部壓力因此不只由靜水深決定。薄層近似可估曲率附加壓力，但水深與速度沿坎面並不一定均勻；過渡曲率突變還可能造成局部分離，須檢查沿程壓力而非只有出口角度。 驗證時應沿曲面布設壓力孔並將低壓區與曲率過渡位置對照，並辨識以下失效情境：曲率接續不平順可能引發分離與局部氣蝕。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Turning flow upward requires centripetal acceleration, so bucket pressure is not purely hydrostatic. A thin-layer approximation estimates added curvature pressure, but depth and velocity vary along the surface. Abrupt curvature transitions can produce separation; examine the pressure distribution instead of checking only the launch angle. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure pressures along the bucket and compare low-pressure regions with curvature transitions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Abrupt curvature transitions can cause separation and local cavitation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 速度水頭與能量~Velocity head and jet energy
units.title: 速度水頭與能量~Velocity head and jet energy
units.mechanism: 離坎水流的速度水頭代表每單位重量所帶動能，挑流只是把能量移到下游空間消散，並未在鼻坎自動消除。出口高程、沿程損失與速度分布共同決定可用能量；要區分水頭、能量與功率，避免量綱混淆。 驗證時應核對入口至離坎的能量線並分別列出高程與速度水頭，並辨識以下失效情境：將射流離開混凝土視為已完全消能會漏掉下游沖擊。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Velocity head represents kinetic energy per unit weight. A flip bucket relocates dissipation downstream rather than eliminating energy at the lip. Elevation, approach losses and velocity distribution determine available energy; distinguish head from energy and power so that apparent dissipation is not a dimensional bookkeeping mistake. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the energy line to the lip and list elevation and velocity heads separately. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating departure from concrete as complete dissipation ignores downstream impact. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 射流功率與承受區~Jet power and receiving zone
units.title: 射流功率與承受區~Jet power and receiving zone
units.mechanism: 水力功率將流量與可耗散水頭結合，描述下游需要處理的能量速率。相同功率可由不同流量與速度組合造成，而沖擊、含氣與岩塊拔出機制不同；因此功率只能作系統尺度指標，不能單獨轉成固定的水墊深度。 驗證時應以流量量測與能量線核對功率並繪製沖擊區分布，並辨識以下失效情境：把總功率均勻攤到全河床會低估集中沖擊強度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Hydraulic power combines discharge and dissipatable head into an energy rate. Equal power can arise from different discharge and velocity combinations with different impact, aeration and rock-block removal behavior. Use power as a system-level indicator rather than converting it directly into a prescribed pool depth. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Verify power from measured discharge and energy head and map the receiving footprint. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Spreading total power uniformly over the whole bed understates concentrated impact. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 含氣展寬與截面~Aeration spreading and jet area
units.title: 含氣展寬與截面~Aeration spreading and jet area
units.mechanism: 空氣捲入會增加水舌混合體積並改變外觀厚度，水量守恆應採液相體積而非混合總體積。均勻含氣率的示意只表達相分率，實際氣泡有滑移與非均勻分布；應同時量測水相流量、混合速度與含氣剖面。 驗證時應以含氣探針與影像量測展寬並核對液相流量守恆，並辨識以下失效情境：將混合截面全當水會高估液相質量與動量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Entrained air expands the apparent jet thickness. Liquid continuity uses water volume, not total mixture volume. A uniform void-fraction model illustrates phase accounting, while real bubbles slip and concentrations vary across the jet. Measure liquid flow, mixture velocity and air profiles together before interpreting the visible envelope. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure spreading with air probes and imaging and check liquid-phase continuity. units.anchor: 入水動量與方向~Impact momentum and direction
units.title: 入水動量與方向~Impact momentum and direction
units.mechanism: 射流入水時的作用取決於速度向量變化，垂直與水平分量對池底與側壁的影響不同。只估完全消除一個分量的平均動量力，不含壓力回授與脈動放大；實際射流可能在水墊中轉向而保留部分動量。 驗證時應以速度剖面與池底壓力積分檢查垂直動量平衡，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略射流轉向後的流出動量會算錯合力方向。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Impact depends on vector velocity change, with vertical and horizontal components loading the pool bed and walls differently. A mean force for arresting one component omits pressure feedback and dynamic amplification. A real jet may turn within the pool and retain momentum rather than stopping completely. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check vertical momentum using velocity profiles and integrated bed pressures. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring outgoing momentum after deflection misstates the resultant force direction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.title: 岩節理揚力與抗力~Joint uplift and rock resistance

Submerged weight is only one resisting component and excludes interlock and shear. Investigate joint connectivity, aperture and block geometry; intact compressive strength alone cannot predict plucking or scour. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Map joints and block sizes and measure pressure differences across connected joints. units.anchor: 福祿尺度與表面張力~Froude scaling and surface tension
units.title: 福祿尺度與表面張力~Froude scaling and surface tension
units.mechanism: 挑流模型常以重力相似重現彈道，但細水舌的破碎與含氣受到表面張力影響，韋伯數可提示這種尺度偏差。相同水質的縮尺模型無法同時保持所有無因次數；應把落點驗證與氣泡破碎驗證分開報告。 驗證時應比較不同模型尺度的水舌破碎長度與無因次落點，並辨識以下失效情境：過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Gravity similarity can reproduce trajectories while surface tension changes thin-jet breakup and aeration. Weber number highlights this scale effect. A reduced model using the same water cannot preserve every dimensionless group simultaneously; report trajectory validation separately from bubble and breakup fidelity instead of treating all observations as equally scalable. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare breakup length and dimensionless landing position between model scales. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration.
